explanation: 51 is 3 times 17, 57 is 3 times 19 and 91 is 7 times 13. A handy test for 3: if the digits add up to a multiple of 3, so does the number.

claims.text: 51 is 3 x 17, 57 is 3 x 19 and 91 is 7 x 13, so none of them is prime.
